Tests that changing a disabled property enables it as well.

Before disable
[expanded] 
element.style  { ()
font-weight: bold;


After disable
[expanded] 
element.style  { ()
/-- overloaded --/ /-- disabled --/ /* font-weight: bold; */


After change
[expanded] 
element.style  { ()
color: green;
